fields.label: Your story
fields.sample:
It all started on an ordinary Tuesday evening, in a small bookstore in Kadıköy. Two hands reaching for the same book at the same moment, a shy smile and the words “You take it, I’ll wait”… One of us kept the book, the other the phone number.
Then came long walks, conversations that lasted till morning, cities we got lost in together. We became each other’s best friend; in laughter and in hard times, we were always on the same side.
One summer evening, a single question asked outside the bookstore where we first met changed everything. The answer was short: “Yes.” Now we want to write the most beautiful page of this story together with you.

fields.label: Thank-you message
fields.sample:
Thank you endlessly for being with us on this journey, for sharing our joy and for making this day unforgettable for us.
We’re so glad to have you; here’s to meeting again on many more happy days.

elements.name: Tebliğ metni
elements.text: The Go Post ed­i­to­ri­al board rec­om­mends that the day in ques­tion be cir­cled in red on every cal­en­dar. Guests are kindly re­quest­ed not to let the date clash with birth­days, meet­ings or sur­prise get­aways. Break­ing in wed­ding shoes is ad­vised start­ing now, as is re­hears­ing dance steps in front of the mirror. This notice takes effect on the date of pub­li­ca­tion. Guests coming from afar are ad­vised to sort out tick­ets and hotels early; those nearby, to book a babysit­ter for the evening. Anyone fail­ing to comply will have to watch the wed­ding in photos. Guests are ex­pect­ed to si­lence their phones on the day and keep their cam­eras ready. It is fur­ther ad­vised that no early ap­point­ments be made for the fol­low­ing morn­ing. Sub­mit­ted for your in­for­ma­tion and due com­pli­ance.

elements.name: Haber başlığı
elements.text: The big day is set: guests are already marking their calendars

elements.name: Haber metni
elements.text:
The news ev­ery­one had waited years for has fi­nal­ly ar­rived. The couple de­cid­ed to an­nounce their wed­ding date first through this news­pa­per; de­tails on the inside pages. Ac­cord­ing to sources close to the couple, three things were weighed when choos­ing the date: fine weath­er, a long day and loved ones all together.
The fam­i­lies ask guests not to make other plans for this date. Ac­com­mo­da­tion and travel tips for out-of-town guests are on page 3; the full sched­ule is on page 2. We have also learned that the formal in­vi­ta­tion will soon be at your door. Those fol­low­ing the prepa­ra­tions close­ly say the most talked-about moment of the night will be the first dance. Word behind the scenes is that the bride’s mother is al­ready prac­tic­ing her dance steps, while the groom is rewrit­ing his speech for the third time.

elements.name: Mekân altyazısı
elements.text: The ceremony will be by the water at sunset.

elements.name: Mekân yazısı
elements.text: The venue is one of the best spots to watch the sunset. The cer­e­mo­ny will be held out­doors by the water; dinner and danc­ing will con­tin­ue in the venue’s hall. If it gets chilly, a light shawl or jacket will do. A re­minder that the garden is lawn: in­stead of stilet­tos, choose com­fort­able shoes that are also good for danc­ing. The venue’s ter­race is re­served for sunset photos; anyone who wants a keep­sake photo with the couple after the cer­e­mo­ny will meet there. Later in the evening, the long tables in the garden will stay open for con­ver­sa­tion and dessert breaks.

elements.name: LCV metni
elements.text: So we don’t forget you when counting tables and chairs: a message or call two weeks before the wedding is all it takes. The sooner you reply, the bigger our joy.

elements.name: Ulaşım metni Araçla
elements.text: Follow the coast road; valet ser­vice will greet you at the venue en­trance. We sug­gest leav­ing half an hour early for evening traf­fic. Park­ing is lim­it­ed, so car­pool if you can or take a taxi.

elements.name: Ulaşım metni Toplu taşıma
elements.text: The near­est bus stop is a five-minute walk from the venue. Guests coming by metro can take a taxi from the last sta­tion and arrive in ten min­utes. On the way back, our shut­tles will drop you down­town.

elements.name: Ulaşım metni Deniz yoluyla
elements.text: The ferry pier is within walk­ing dis­tance of the venue. Ar­riv­ing from the op­po­site shore at sunset is the loveli­est en­trance you could make. Don’t forget to check the time of the last ferry.

elements.name: Ulaşım metni Konaklama
elements.text: We’ve ar­ranged spe­cial rates at nearby hotels for our out-of-town guests. Just write to us for de­tails; we rec­om­mend book­ing rooms early.
